correctness.rationale: The exact RK325 normalized stage polynomial follows by direct Cartesian substitution. Exact symbolic coefficients give the only nonstationary cancellation and its nonzero tenth-order coefficient, and the scaled recurrence is an Euler approximation to an explicitly solved Riccati equation with local O(H^10) error. Bounded-interval Gronwall proves O(H^2) global rescaled error for every T<128. The included stand-alone verifier checks symbolic coefficients, the scaled coefficient and twelve independent exact rational Cartesian updates. The finite-time limiting pole is not alleged to be an actual discrete blow-up.

value.rationale: The resonant radius is determined uniquely and non-arbitrarily as the positive nonstationary root of the leading energy-error coefficient in the motivated cubic amplitude-frequency family. The fourth-order reduction of the leading defect and nontrivial sharply timed Riccati limit expose how the local accuracy improvement interacts with long-run drift, a distinct and useful stability benchmark. The theorem neither trivializes as a change of notation nor follows from generic fifth-order accuracy.
